GameConditionDef.label: Disruptor EMI field
GameConditionDef.description: An electromagnetic interference dynamo is projecting an EM interference field, disabling electrical devices. For the first hour, buildings such as turrets will be stunned.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a distant EMI dynamo will blast [map_definite] with an EMI field, shutting down electrical devices for [gameConditionDuration_duration]
GameConditionDef.letterText: An EMI field has been generated. It is disabling electrical devices.
